detail.requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
• 2-5 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, data management, or related fields.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
• Experience working with large datasets and managing complex data processes.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
• Experience using data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar platforms.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work effectively across cross-functional and multicultural teams.
• Fluent Korean and business-level English communication skills.
detail.main_tasks:
• Support the operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the APAC data analytics platform to ensure data quality and reliable reporting.
• Perform master data management, data validation, and data quality monitoring activities to maintain data integrity and consistency.
• Investigate and resolve data- and system-related issues in collaboration with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams.
• Support user adoption through training, communications, and ongoing end-user support.
• Participate in system enhancement initiatives, user acceptance testing (UAT), and process improvement projects.
• Manage and maintain regular data operations, including manual data handling, file uploads, and process ownership activities.
• Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams by translating business requirements and unmet needs into actionable enhancement requests.
• Prepare and update monthly business reports using the latest available data for leadership teams and commercial stakeholders.
• Validate reporting outputs to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
• Provide analytical insights and recommendations to support business planning and performance management.
• Coordinate follow-up actions and stakeholder communications related to reporting outputs and findings.
• Conduct ad-hoc analyses using internal and external datasets to address business questions and support decision making.
• Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis and communicate findings to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.
• Develop data-driven recommendations that support commercial and operational business objectives.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, data governance standards, and applicable business procedures.
detail.intro: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity.
detail.preferred_points:
• Experience supporting regional or global data and analytics platforms.
• Knowledge of master data management (MDM), data governance, and data quality frameworks.
• Experience with user acceptance testing (UAT) and system enhancement projects.
• Exposure to pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or consumer health industries.
• Knowledge of SQL or other data querying tools is preferred.
